title: Informative censoring on the two sides of an indirect comparison
question: When censoring depends on latent risk in the source and comparator trials to different degrees, does the bias cancel in the indirect RMST contrast, what does source-side IPCW achieve, and does a one-sided comparator sensitivity analysis cover the truth?
design: Shared-frailty event and censoring processes with separate dependence in the source and comparator; 24 cells crossing the two dependences, censoring prevalence and anchored or unanchored design; naive Kaplan-Meier, source-side IPCW and a comparator delta-adjusted sensitivity analysis. 1000 replicates per cell.
